name: layout-owning-blocks
method: Read each block.json + render.php under src/blocks/. A block is 'layout-owning' if it (a) declares `supports.layout` in block.json, OR (b) emits an outer wrapper with grid/flex direction or row-gap that establishes a flow context for its inner blocks (typical of container/template blocks). For dynamic blocks, also check render.php for any wrapping <div> with display:grid|flex emitted with direct CSS or block-class selectors.

result.name: mvs/media-grid
result.evidence: render.php emits <div class="mvs-media-grid mvs-cols-{N}"> with style.css setting display:grid + grid-template-columns. Children are media cards, not inner blocks — but the outer is a layout container for its dynamic children.

result.name: mvs/album-viewer
result.evidence: Renders an inner media-grid via do_blocks() — inherits layout from media-grid.

result.name: mvs/explore-feed
result.evidence: block.json declares `supports.layout: { allowSwitching: true }` (verified). Acts as the explore page container.

result.name: mvs/explore-view
result.evidence: Page-level container; not user-insertable but renders as the Explore page tree.

result.name: mvs/member-photos
result.evidence: 1.2.0 NEW. Auto-resolves user, then delegates to do_blocks(media-grid). Inherits layout-owning from inner media-grid. block.json declares supports.align[wide,full] but no supports.layout — that's correct because it's not user-insertable as a Site Editor flow container, just a wrapped grid.

result.name: mvs/pdf-viewer
result.evidence: 1.2.0 NEW. Single-media iframe embed. block.json correctly omits supports.layout. Treats height as a fixed-pixel attribute (clamped 200-1400). Iframe is not a flow container for inner blocks. Correct value: layout_owning=false.

result.name: mvs/lock-overlay
result.evidence: Static lock overlay; CSS-positioned absolute over a media item.

result.name: mvs/shared-ui
result.evidence: Footer-level singleton mounting modals + toast — has no inner-block layout.

verification_summary.manifest_status: manifest.json::blocks[] does NOT currently emit a `layout_owning` field. The skill spec calls for it; the manifest schema v2.2 has it as optional. Recommend adding it in next manifest refresh — values per this verification table.

notes: Verification complete for the two 1.2.0 additions. Member-photos correctly inherits layout-owning from the wrapped media-grid; pdf-viewer correctly does not own layout. The bigger finding is that the manifest does not currently emit layout_owning at all; future refresh should add it. Not a 1.2.0 regression — pre-existing manifest gap.
